messages:
Hiro: hey all, day 3 here. we have an external consultant joining tomorrow who needs temporary staging Console access to help triage feature flags. what's the recommended flow? cc @people-ops
Sam: welcome Hiro! vendor/consultant access is gated. people-ops creates a time-bound Okta group and we issue a scoped service account or SSO session. Security reviews the SSO claims.
Hiro: ok. do we give them a user token or a service account? they won't be committing infra changes, just toggling/observing staging flags.
people-ops: prefer a service account tied to the vendor with explicit expiration. name it sa-vendor-<vendor>-staging and limit scopes to console.flags.read, console.flags.write. We'll also require an NDA + authorized user list.
Hiro: how do we prove the NDA was signed in the request?
people-ops: attach the signed NDA to the people-ops ticket and include the Okta group membership CSV. We'll enqueue a Security review.
security: we need justification + monitoring plan and a 2FA requirement for the session approver. Also enable verbose audit logs for all actions by that SA.
Hiro: audit logs OK. does Console support making SA actions visible as "vendor-name:sa" in the logs?
Sam: yes, infra maps SA id to a display name. include the vendor identifier in the SA name when requesting. infra will turn on the "vendor_audit" flag for that tenant for the duration.
Hiro: timeline? consultant arrives 09:00 UTC tomorrow. how fast can we get this approved?
people-ops: open request: https://redwood.internal/access-requests -> choose "vendor-temp-sa" and attach NDA + list. If you tag @people-ops and @security we can fast-track to a 4-hour SLA.
Hiro: filing now. thanks! I'll include exact flag names and a rollback checklist.
access-bot: Vendor access request VND-778 created by Hiro. Status: awaiting people-ops review :hourglass:
people-ops: once approved, infra will provision the SA and post the token to the secure vault. Share the vault path with the consultant and set TTL to match the expiry.
Hiro: perfect, appreciate the help :pray:
